hazard.name: Severe Weather
hazard.description: Atmospheric conditions posing immediate risk including high winds, hail, and convective storm activity.

hazard.name: Heavy Rainfall & Cloudburst
hazard.description: Precipitation exceeding 64.5 mm/day or intense convective cloudburst exceeding 100 mm/hour.

hazard.name: Flash Flood & River Inundation
hazard.description: Rapid surge in river water volume and sudden breach of natural or artificial channel banks.

hazard.name: Landslide & Slope Failure
hazard.description: Downward movement of rock, debris, or earth mass triggered by intense precipitation or seismic shaking.

hazard.name: Infrastructure & Road Blockage
hazard.description: Complete obstruction of critical highway corridors and vehicular access routes due to debris or road collapse.

hazard.name: Earthquake & Seismic Event
hazard.description: Seismic ground shaking along Himalayan fault lines.

value.title: NH-107 Kedarnath Highway Road Blockage at Basukedar

value.caption: Massive debris mass spanning NH-107 near Basukedar bridge

text_item.title: USDMA Incident SITREP #04: NH-107 Kedarnath Highway Road Blockage at Basukedar
text_item.body: Massive debris slide triggered by 128.4mm rainfall at Basukedar along NH-107. Road completely severed over 340 meters. SDRF teams dispatched from Agastyamuni. 420 pilgrims and 65 vehicles safely rerouted to designated transit shelters.
text_item.author: Dr. V. K. Negi, SEOC In-Charge

source_score.methodology: Cross-validation with IMD automated weather stations
NRSC Field Audits in Garhwal Himalaya

event.name: Heavy Rainfall in Mandakini Catchment
event.confidence_method: Multi-station telemetry corroborated with IMD Doppler radar
event.verification_notes: Corroborated by CWC Basukedar, CWC Rudraprayag, and IMD AWS
event.description: Continuous cloudburst-induced heavy precipitation across Rudraprayag upper catchment reaching 128.4 mm in 6 hours.

event.name: Mandakini River Surging Above Warning Mark
event.description: Rapid water surge in Mandakini River threatening low-lying ghats and settlements downstream of Agastyamuni.

event.name: Basukedar Major Landslide on NH-107
event.confidence_method: SDRF SITREP + Geotagged Drone Imagery + BRO On-site Survey
event.verification_notes: SDRF Quick Response Team on site; BRO Task Force 752 deployed with excavators
event.description: Major slope failure triggering rockfall and debris avalanche across Kedarnath Highway (NH-107) near Basukedar.

event.name: NH-107 Kedarnath Highway Road Blockage
event.confidence_method: District Police Dispatch + BRO Ground Confirmation
event.verification_notes: Vehicular movement suspended between Agastyamuni and Kund
event.description: Complete vehicular cutoff along 340m stretch of National Highway 107. Traffic diverted via Tehri bypass.

event.name: Mandakini Flash Flood Downstream Warning
event.confidence_method: Causal Cascade GNN Prediction + Gauge Inflow Model
event.verification_notes: Debris dam impoundment breach warning issued by SEOC
event.description: Secondary flash flood wave generated by potential debris dam breach in Basukedar tributary stream.

evidence.notes: Tributary blockage could release sudden flood surge

event_group.name: Rudraprayag Heavy Rainfall & Cascading Landslide Episode
event_group.description: A severe hydrometeorological cascading disaster episode initiated by localized cloudburst in upper Mandakini basin, inducing steep slope failure at Basukedar, catastrophic blockage of Kedarnath Highway (NH-107), and downstream river inundation threat.

event_group.name: Chamoli Glacial Stream Surge & Catchment Alert
event_group.description: High glacial melt and localized precipitation surge triggering high alert along Dhauliganga river banks.
